subject: this repo's vendored create-new-feature.sh predates card 126: it allocates spec numbers by local scan and checks out a branch from inside a card worktree
activeForm: Propagating the card-aware spec-number allocator into this repository

work_items: Propagate the card-aware create-new-feature.sh (and its common.sh) from ~/dotfiles/.specify/ into this repo's .specify/
Verify it reads specNumber from cards/<id>.json in a card worktree and refuses rather than walking
Verify it no longer runs git checkout -b, which from a card worktree moves the Dynamo off its own branch

description:
FOUND BY CARD 8 while minting specs/1401. Not card 8's work; reported rather than fixed, because it is vendored spec-kit shared with every repo and deserves its own change.

THE DEFECT. /home/zeebo/worktrees/sentiment-analyzer-gsk/card-8/.specify/scripts/bash/create-new-feature.sh is the PRE-card-126 version. Measured: `grep -c specNumber` returns 0 on this repo's copy and 7 on ~/dotfiles/.specify/scripts/bash/create-new-feature.sh. Two consequences, both live:

1. It allocates by scanning the invoking worktree -- check_existing_branches() takes max+1 over remote branches, local branches and specs/ dirs. That is exactly the allocator card 126 retired, and it is how four sessions once minted four different specs/103. A sibling Dynamo's uncommitted allocation is invisible to any scan.
2. It runs `git checkout -b "$BRANCH_NAME"` unconditionally. Run from a card worktree it would move the Dynamo OFF card-<id> onto a new NNN-slug branch mid-work. The card-aware version creates no branch at all.

WHAT CARD 8 DID INSTEAD. Invoked the correct allocator from ~/dotfiles against this worktree. It read specNumber 1401 off cards/8.json, minted specs/1401-deploy-gate-can-fail/ at exactly that number, and left the branch on card-8. Verified with --dry-run first. That is a workaround, not a fix: the next Dynamo in this repo that follows speckit.specify.md's instruction to run `.specify/scripts/bash/create-new-feature.sh` without --number gets the stale copy and the old behaviour.

SCOPE NOTE. Other repos on this host carry the same stale copy: interview-python, openclaw-mac, sentiment-analyzer-gsk-hardening, job-watch, terraform-gsk-template, and the sentiment-analyzer-gsk root checkout. Only ~/dotfiles, ~/bench-run-150 and ~/worktrees/dotfiles/card-150 have the card-aware one. Whether propagation is per-repo or a host-level sync is the open design question and belongs to whoever takes this card.

PARITY. ~/dotfiles/specs/118-spec-number-allocation/tests/test-spec-number-allocation.sh exists and drives both the script and tools/spec-number.py over one tree requiring the same answer. Use it rather than writing a new suite.
